construct: Leptin is an adipocyte-derived signal of energy stores that acts in the hypothalamus to promote satiety and support neuroendocrine reproductive function. Complete leptin deficiency causes severe early-onset hyperphagia and obesity and can cause hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Severe infantile hyperphagia/obesity with nearly absent leptin despite high adiposity and biallelic LEP loss means the missing signal is adipocyte-derived leptin to hypothalamic satiety circuits.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Insulin, ghrelin, GLP-1, and cortisol originate from other organs and do not represent the LEP gene product or the specific missing adiposity signal.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Leptin-receptor deficiency can resemble the phenotype, but the stem has nearly undetectable leptin and biallelic LEP variants, uniquely identifying hormone deficiency rather than receptor resistance.
